EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows very intense bands at 604 cm⁻¹ and 640 cm⁻¹, a pattern typical for halogen-containing S–Cl / C–Cl stretches (GFQ-041, GFQ-046).  Additional strong bands appear at 1192 cm⁻¹ and 1340 cm⁻¹, matching the symmetric and asymmetric ν(S=O) vibrations of a sulfonyl group (GFQ-022 analogue for SO₂, typical 1150–1200 cm⁻¹ and 1320–1360 cm⁻¹).  A medium band near 1030 cm⁻¹ is consistent with ν(S–N) of sulfonamides, and weak C–H bending at 1430 cm⁻¹ plus C–H stretches at 2916–3030 cm⁻¹ fit an aliphatic heterocycle.  Among the candidates, only molecule 2 (O=C1CN(S(=O)(=O)Cl)C1) contains a sulfonyl chloride (SO₂Cl) group together with aliphatic C–H, providing a coherent explanation for all key peaks.
